selfReportedHint: Straight from your own terminal — Studio did not run this and cannot verify it.
title: Verify externally
intro: Run your Playwright test in your own terminal, then paste the reporter output below. Studio only reads what you paste.
commandTitle: Commands to run in your own terminal
commandWhyChromium: The --project=chromium flag matters: R6 needs a Chromium run, so the report must name it.
copyFailed: Could not copy — select the command and copy it yourself.
pastePlaceholder: Paste the whole JSON report or the list output here…
uploadHint: A .json or .txt file saved from your terminal, up to 1 MB.
uploadTooLarge: That file is larger than 1 MB. Save the reporter output again and retry.
uploadUnreadable: That file could not be read as text. Check that it is the reporter output.
versionUnknown: Playwright version unknown (the list reporter does not print it)
noSpecs: No spec files in this report.
unrecognized: This does not look like Playwright output — check that you copied the whole report.
confirmLabel: I confirm these facts match the run I just did
confirmHint: Studio cannot verify them; they are stored as self-reported evidence.
confirmRequired: Tick the box above once the facts look right.
submitRequiresEvidence: Paste and confirm your Playwright report before submitting.
reviseHint: The review below points at what to change. Run your spec again in your own terminal, paste the new report, and submit — the new attempt is linked to this one.
revisingAttempt: Revising attempt {n} — submit when your new run is ready.
specCodeHint: Paste the spec you ran. Studio reads it for the review and never executes it.
historyTransitions: What changed since the previous attempt
historyNoChange: No criterion changed since the previous attempt.

command.json_file: JSON report written to results.json (easiest to paste or upload)
command.json_stdout: JSON report printed to the terminal (copy the whole output)
command.list: List report (accepted too; it carries no Playwright version)

warning.count_mismatch: The counts in the report do not add up.
warning.unknown_spec_files: Some reported spec files are not in the code you submitted.
warning.claimed_pass_with_failures: Your write-up claims a green run, but the report contains failures.
warning.unrecognized_format: This does not look like Playwright reporter output.
warning.truncated: The report was too long and was cut down.
